summary: Two brothers from the Woodland Park area went off-roading in the backcountry Saturday afternoon and were overdue as a spring storm dropped 1+ ft of snow; Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery fielded its first-ever search operation (led by Matt Radder and founder Craig "CJ" Lehman), prioritizing likely roads to locate their truck for handoff to foot SAR; after several hours the boys were found alive, having sheltered overnight in a cabin, ill-equipped for the storm.
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery; Colorado Springs Police
notes: Date approximate: boys last seen Saturday afternoon 2016-03-05 (KRDO public appeal aired Mon 2016-03-07 6:55am); KRDO report notes the brothers had previously off-roaded in El Paso, Teller, and Park counties. CO4x4RnR first-ever search operation and first TV press (Lehman interviewed). KRDO OCR transcript garbles the boys' names — omitted per incident-focus rule.
